claims.quote: We switched from a Mamba1 (Gu & Dao, 2023) to a Mamba2 (Dao & Gu, 2024) backbone. We found that Mamba2 has significantly higher throughput than an equivalently sized Mamba1, with approximately the same performance.
claims.reason: Authors list the Mamba1→Mamba2 backbone switch, and the larger state-size tradeoff, as one of the architecture improvements from their ablations (ARCH contribution), not merely a citation of Dao & Gu. Ablation=NO: the report only asserts higher throughput at equal size in prose; it does not present a with-vs-without comparison at matched size, data, and tokens (no table or curves), so the lower level applies.
